    - link "Press release Fugro secures long-term funding with new facility from the European Investment Bank and two-year extension of existing senior debt facilities Fugro has entered into a EUR 150 million unsecured financing facility with the European Investment Bank (EIB) to support the ongoing development and deployment of its uncrewed surface vessel (USV) technology. The facility will support the phased expansion of Fugro's remote operations capabilities, allowing the company to progress its transformation programme, while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation. 14 Oct 2026":
